title: Tumor Board Case Review — MSS-adjacent HGSOC with MBD4-loss
subtitle: Case-level readout from the CrisPRO analysis engine. Every recommendation, ruling-out, and evidence anchor is grounded in the patient bundle and reproducible from the source registry.

case_context.cancer: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC), Stage IVB
case_context.situation: Post 4 cycles carboplatin + bevacizumab. Advanced disease burden. Germline MBD4-loss hypermutator context. Currently at L1 analysis depth (bundle completeness 55%, confidence cap 0.6).
case_context.key_question: What treatment options fit this tumor's biology best, and which classes should be actively ruled out to avoid unproductive lines?
case_context.data_completeness: 55% (bundle contains IHC, germline, three scored mutations; missing: HRD assay, TMB, RNA-seq, CA-125).

stages.name: Case Overview
stages.plain_language: Compact summary for the room. What is on the record, what is not.

patient_summary.disease_burden: Advanced — peritoneal carcinomatosis, pleural effusions, lymph node involvement
patient_summary.germline: MBD4 c.1293delA homozygous pathogenic — hypermutator context
missing_data: HRD score (Myriad myChoice CDx or equivalent)

stages.name: Data Readiness — What Would Sharpen the Analysis
stages.plain_language: The bundle is at 55% completeness with a confidence cap of 0.6. Four tests would unlock additional evidence modalities. Each is described with its downstream impact.

data_shown.confidence_cap: 0.6 — no recommendation can exceed this confidence until missing data is added

missing_tests.test: HRD assay (Myriad myChoice CDx or equivalent)
missing_tests.priority: Recommended (does not change the PARP finding)
missing_tests.clinical_impact: The PARP mechanism check is already complete (p=0.605 in MBD4-LOF, see stage 4). HRD adds an independent readout of HR-repair status but does not re-open PARP eligibility on its own.
MBD4-LOF predicts CpG→TpG driver mutagenesis. TMB confirms whether the patient falls in the responder subgroup where checkpoint-based combinations become viable.

missing_tests.unlocks: Expression association tier + IO checkpoint receptivity
missing_tests.clinical_impact: Currently 2 of 4 evidence modalities are blocked at INSUFFICIENT. RNA restores expression-based mechanism scoring.

missing_tests.unlocks: Serum tumor-marker trend for response monitoring
missing_tests.clinical_impact: Standard ovarian serum marker. Does not alter drug ranking but supports response monitoring on any regimen.

data_shown.recommendation: Ordering all four in parallel is feasible from existing tissue. Total turnaround estimated 2–3 weeks. Every recommendation below survives regardless of results; the tests refine confidence, not direction.

stages.name: Drug Ranking — Recommended vs. Actively Ruled Out
stages.plain_language: The engine ranks by mechanism-fit, not by drug-class default. Two classes come out on top; three PARP inhibitors are demoted with an explicit falsification rationale rather than hidden.

data_shown.how_it_works: For each candidate drug, the engine scores mechanistic fit to the tumor's specific biology (MBD4-LOF context, MSS status, PD-L1 CPS 10). Rows are surfaced with either "recommended" or a falsification reason — hiding falsified rows is disallowed by design so the audit trail is visible at the point of decision.

drugs.name: Ceralasertib (ATR inhibitor)
drugs.fit_rationale: Primary mechanism match. In cell-line drug-sensitivity data (GDSC LN_IC50), MBD4-LOF lines are significantly more sensitive to ceralasertib than MBD4-wildtype lines (p=0.021, Cohen d=-0.50, n_lof=14 vs n_wt=914).
drugs.blocking_factor: Access is via clinical trial. No blocking factor in the bundle itself.

drugs.name: Adavosertib (WEE1 inhibitor)
drugs.fit_rationale: Same DNA-replication-stress axis as ATR inhibition. Grouped with ceralasertib as the primary_new_candidate_axis in the SL matrix (divergenceIntended:true — this is the PR#11 mechanism that supersedes the older PARP-first heuristic).
drugs.blocking_factor: Access via trial; combined ATR+WEE1 arms exist.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab + chemotherapy
drugs.fit_rationale: PD-L1 CPS 10 provides IO rationale; MSS status limits single-agent efficacy. Discussion-level option for combination-context trials.
drugs.blocking_factor: MSS single-agent IO is not indicated. Combination-only context.

drugs.name: Doxorubicin (liposomal)
drugs.fit_rationale: Standard second-line option for platinum-resistant HGSOC. Mechanism-independent of the MBD4-LOF finding.
drugs.blocking_factor: Depends on platinum-free interval and cumulative anthracycline dose.

ranking_categories.tier: Tier 3 — Actively ruled out (mechanism check completed)

drugs.name: Olaparib (PARP inhibitor)
drugs.fit_rationale: PARP1 expression in MBD4-LOF samples (n=19) vs controls (n=1498): p=0.605 — no association. The correlation between PARP1 activity and PARP-inhibitor sensitivity exists in the general pool (ρ=-0.42, p=1.4×10⁻²¹, n=481) but MBD4-LOF specifically does not share it. Mechanism ruled out.
drugs.blocking_factor: Mechanism does not support the drug in this tumor context. HRD result will not reopen this row.
drugs.estimated_fit: falsified:true (see stage 5 SL matrix, parp_inhibitors row, manuscriptClaimType=falsified_mechanism)

drugs.name: Niraparib (PARP inhibitor)
drugs.fit_rationale: Same class rationale and same falsification as olaparib. Broader HRD-positive eligibility does not restore mechanism support in MBD4-LOF.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (HER2)
drugs.fit_rationale: HER2-negative on IHC. No mechanistic rationale.

data_shown.ranking_note: Falsified rows remain visible in the evidence matrix (audit-preserving). The bridge policy for L1 explicitly disallows hiding a falsified row; instead it displays the row with the falsification reason so the reasoning is inspectable at the point of care.

stages.name: PARP Falsification Arc — The Evidence Trail
stages.plain_language: The single most-requested class in ovarian oncology is PARP. Because the engine actively demotes it here, the full mechanism check is shown so the reasoning is inspectable at tumor-board level.

items.label: Primary anchor — ceralasertib in MBD4-LOF
items.context: GDSC LN_IC50 comparison. Effect size medium, sample size adequate. This is the observation that anchors the ATR-inhibitor recommendation.

items.label: Falsification arm — PARP1 in MBD4-LOF
items.context: PARP1 expression compared between MBD4-LOF and MBD4-WT samples. No association. Large control pool rules out a power issue.

items.label: Positive control — pan-cancer PARP1↔PARPi correlation
items.context: Confirms the mechanism-to-drug link exists at high N in the general cancer pool. MBD4-LOF lines do not share the pattern — this is the specificity check that upgrades "no evidence" to "evidence of no effect."

items.label: Reproducibility
items.value: Every value above traceable to the AK01 bundle fields (AK_PARP_FALSIFICATION.prodShipsToday, .manuscriptSays, .pr11Fix)
items.context: The falsification block ships as a first-class field on the bundle so the audit is preserved. Nothing here is generated at render time.

stages.name: Synthetic-Lethality Matrix
stages.plain_language: The 6-axis SL matrix is what the engine used to reason from biology. One row (atr_wee1) is a primary_new_candidate_axis with divergenceIntended=true. One row (parp_inhibitors) is explicitly manuscriptClaimType=falsified_mechanism.

data_shown.how_it_works: Each axis is a class-level SL pairing between the tumor's driver (MBD4-LOF) and a drug class. Each row carries a tier + a manuscript_claim_type so the audit trail from L1 → recommended drugs is inspectable.
data_shown.current_status: L1 matrix populated (6 axes). Divergence between prod tier and PR#11 sim tier is intentional on the atr_wee1 axis (that is the mechanism advance).

potential_pairs.requires: RNA-seq for expression confirmation; trial access for ceralasertib / adavosertib.

potential_pairs.evidence_level: falsified_mechanism (p=0.605 in MBD4-LOF; positive control ρ=-0.42 confirms specificity of the negative)
potential_pairs.requires: No action — row kept for audit; not recommended.

data_shown.what_unlocks_it: Adding TMB and RNA-seq elevates confidence cap from 0.6 to L2 (patient-driven capability gates). This does not change the direction of any Tier-1 or Tier-3 recommendation.

stages.name: Evidence Assembly
stages.plain_language: Every claim above is packaged with source pointers. The evidence vault supports export for second-opinion review or IRB documentation.

what_it_contains.items: AK_TUMOR_CONTEXT (IHC), AK_MUTATIONS (3 scored variants), AK_COMPLETENESS (score + missing list), AK_RECOMMENDED_DRUGS (5-drug ranking with falsification flags), AK_SL_MATRIX (6-axis matrix), AK_SL_PROVENANCE (per-row provenance), AK_PARP_FALSIFICATION (three-part evidence: primary anchor, falsification arm, positive control), AK_TESTS_NEEDED (four-test roadmap).
GDSC LN_IC50 (ceralasertib primary anchor). PARP1 expression corpus (falsification arm). Pan-cancer PARP1↔PARPi correlation dataset (positive control).
18-boolean SurfaceCapabilities contract over the patient bundle. Doctrine: presence in the bundle is truth — no stubs, no "not available for this patient" placeholder cards.

data_shown.traceability: Every rendered field carries a bundle path (e.g. levels.L1.synthetic_lethality.recommended_drugs[0]) that leads to the raw source. No number in this readout was generated at render time.
data_shown.export_options: PDF (case summary + evidence trail), JSON (raw bundle + capability gate readout), tumor-board-slide export (roadmap).

stages.name: Strategic Priorities
stages.plain_language: For the tumor-board decision — three next actions ranked by mechanism impact.

actions: Screen open ceralasertib and adavosertib trials for ovarian / MBD4-LOF / DDR contexts.
Confirm MBD4-LOF germline result meets any trial pre-screening requirement.
If a combination ATR/WEE1 arm is available, prioritize based on toxicity profile discussion.
Order HRD, TMB, RNA-seq, and CA-125 in parallel from existing tissue block.
Confidence cap lifts from 0.6 once RNA and TMB return.
PARP mechanism ruling stands regardless of results.
Discuss whether TMB result (once returned) opens a checkpoint-combination trial arm.
PD-L1 CPS 10 is supportive but not sufficient standalone in MSS.
Reserve as second-line consideration after ATR/WEE1 access is determined.

data_shown.bottom_line: Recommended direction: ATR / WEE1 inhibitor trial. Actively ruled out: PARP inhibitors (mechanism check complete, HRD result will not reopen). Complete data readiness (HRD/TMB/RNA/CA-125) in parallel — direction stands regardless of results, but confidence cap lifts.
